destination.name: Quzhou
destination.tagline: A walled southern Zhejiang city holding Confucian heritage, Go lore and glass-floored gorges
destination.description: Quzhou is a prefecture-level city in western Zhejiang with a walled old quarter and the Nankong Confucian temple. The Confucius South Family Temple marks where the sage's southern branch settled after the Song court fled south. In the hills nearby, Lanke Mountain is tied to Go legends, while Yaowang Mountain and Tianji Longmen Gorge offer glass skywalks and a gorge zip line.

goodToKnow.title: Hire a car or driver
goodToKnow.detail: The mountain and gorge sights lie outside the city and public transport is thin. A car with driver saves time.

goodToKnow.title: Check weather for glass walks
goodToKnow.detail: Skywalks and slides can close in rain or strong wind, so confirm on the day before the trip out.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Quzhou is at its best in {months}, with mild days that suit its hill walks and old streets.
